shortfall_reason: No concept shortfall: 20 distinct concepts accepted after independently reopening all 19 cited primary-source bodies and checking all 76 factual fields. All 20 existing_entry_id values resolve exactly once among 34 original fashion-items entries and match their Korean titles; this is enrichment of existing concepts, not 20 newly acquired items. Oxford/Derby have different construction; watches differ by strap construction; scarf/pocket square differ by item/use. Product colour, nominal size and open/closed states are not separately counted. Product-example specifications do not verify the original guides' products, exact colours, observed fit, contact or performance. All numerical facts remain source claims; observations, reviewer measurements, proposals and media candidates are zero. No media acquired or licence granted. No unsupported field required rejecting a concept. This review does not stage accepted files, modify seed data or claim the broader category is complete.
